about: Props read out of the owner's game Folk Valley. Each model is a list of Roblox Parts. A model's frame is the middle of its footprint on the ground (Y up). Part row: [name, class, sizeX, sizeY, sizeZ, posX, posY, posZ, rotX, rotY, rotZ, colourHex, material, surfaces, shape, transparency, canCollide]. Rotation is in radians as used by CFrame.fromOrientation(rotX, rotY, rotZ) (applied Y, then X, then Z). surfaces: 'In' = Inlet on all six faces, 'St' = Studs, 'Sm' = Smooth; twelve letters = one pair per face in the order Top, Bottom, Front, Back, Left, Right.
